rules.content:
/*
ShinySp1d3r ransomware
*/

rule ShinySp1d3r_Ransomnote
{
    meta:
        author = "ransomware.live"
        family = "ransomware.shinysp1d3r"
        description = "Detects ShinySp1d3r ransomware ransom note or artifact"
        date = "2026-05-04"
        severity = 7
        score = 70

    strings:
        $name1 = "ShinySp1d3r" ascii nocase
        $name2 = "SHINYSP1D3R" ascii
        $onion  = "shinysp1d3r.onion" ascii nocase

    condition:
        any of them
}
